tay: Quick sync: policy engine needs to distinguish hard constraints (filters) vs soft constraints (penalties). we had a tenant hit a dedicated-only rule but still routed to shared. propose a cheap pre-filter stage.

anish: +1. do hard-filter first (boolean checks), short-circuit. keeps scoring cheap.

rachel: migration nuance: many legacy flags are preference-like. plan: introduce enums HARD, SOFT, SOFT_STRICT and map legacy flags to SOFT for 30d with owner review.

liam: pipeline sketch: gather -> hard-filter drop -> baseline scoring -> penalty layering -> deterministic tie-break. tie-break = small jitter derived from request-id + transform_v so ordering is reproducible.

priya: ops constraints: every hard-filter must emit reason_code and be auditable. add fail-open fallback if control-plane down and a circuit that pages if filters drop >90% of candidates. cache filter_v in route cache.

policy-bot: policy-audit: added filter enums to schema v3. candidate_drop events will include reason_code.

anish: telemetry: emit pre/post candidate counts and top drop reasons per-minute. also gate-open metric for fail-open.

liam: rollout: feature flag, unit + e2e tests, 5% canary for 24h. rollback if candidate_drop_rate >2x or tenant-error-rate up >0.1%.

tay: ACTIONS: tay draft RFC for hard-filter stage + schema v3; rachel prepare migration plan; anish prototype jitter util; liam add router tests; priya design audit dashboard. RFC by EOD. :white_check_mark:
